legal_version_unreconciled: The frozen US wording differs: DMG 64020 says no new claims could be made from 8.4.87, while DMG 28065 and 51033 say the supplement was removed from the scheme on 6.4.87 but could continue in payment. Preserve both dates and descriptions as potentially different events; do not silently normalise them to a single closure date.
requirements.scope: DMG Chapter 28 expressly scopes the income treatment to IS/JSA(IB), distinguishes basic IIDB/REA/US from attendance additions and retains the statutory meaning of attendance allowance. Chapter 17 is a separate payment-adjustment plane. Do not transfer JSA(IB) means-test rules to contributory or New Style JSA.
